documents.title: PixelPort: return policy
documents.text:
PixelPort Electronics - return policy (excerpt)
Accessories (mice, keyboards, headsets, cables): opened accessories carry a non-refundable processing fee of $8.00 per item. Unopened accessories are refunded in full.
Monitors and computers: full refund within 30 days if returned complete.
Refunds go to store credit unless you select the original payment method. Approved card refunds post 2 business days after approval.
The processing fee is disclosed at checkout and is not a billing error.

rules: request_refund for X-110 is approved the next business day for the policy amount ($52.00) regardless of the amount requested, and posts 2 business days after approval (by 2026-10-22 for any request by 2026-10-18).
request_refund for M-27Q is declined: the item was not returned.
open_dispute on tx-7120 is accepted and recorded as an unauthorized dispute of a valid fee.
